run.name: Encore Capital Group Inc
run.title: CP-OS host session (ECPG)
run.summary: Encore is an improving but still highly levered debt purchaser: leverage fell to 5.13x and cash interest cover rose to 3.07x, but revolver availability narrowed to USD 510.2 million and earnings quality depends on collection forecasts. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context; the EDGAR registrant name in that context is ENCORE CAPITAL GROUP INC.

leverage.basis: Total debt / EBITDA. Principal debt 4,267,981 (Q3 10-Q page:19 "4,267,981 4,033,394") less cash 158,425 (Q3 10-Q page:2 "Cash and cash equivalents $ 158,425 $ 156,784"); LTM Adjusted EBITDA 831,829 calculated as FY2025 plus nine months 2026 644,320 less nine months 2025 489,449 (Q3 10-Q page:51 "Adjusted EBITDA $ 245,171 $ 184,756 $ 644,320 $ 489,449"). Cash includes cash of consolidated securitisation vehicles and client cash, not separated; carrying borrowings are 4,237,800 after 30,181 of discount and costs.

coverage.basis: EBITDA / cash interest. LTM Adjusted EBITDA 831,829 over LTM cash interest 270,515, calculated as FY2025 259,812 plus nine months 2026 183,459 less nine months 2025 172,756 (Q3 10-Q page:6 "Cash paid for interest $ 183,459 $ 172,756"). Cash interest is lumpy because coupons fall on semi-annual dates, so single quarters are not used.

cash.basis: Cash. Cash 158,425 thousand (Q3 10-Q page:2), of which 54.8 is held by U.S.-based entities and 103.6 by foreign entities (Q3 10-Q page:58). Issuer-stated availability (Q3 10-Q page:20 "was approximately $510.2 million as of September"), equal to commitment of 1,485.0 less drawn 974.8. Cash includes consolidated securitisation vehicle cash of 48,558 thousand and client cash of 10.4 US$m, not separated. No letters of credit figure is supplied.

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: Covenant ratios, seller concentration, ratings and executed financing terms are not available.
CP-1 main limitation: The earnings measure is the company's own Adjusted EBITDA, and no covenant ratios or executed agreements are available.
